Severity: MAJOR from four reviewers, BLOCKER from one (gemini, for the trust-boundary framing); highest used. Fix is `env -u GIT_DIR -u GIT_WORK_TREE`, as in implement.yml:1477.
- tests/test_review_autofix_step_fallback_verify.py:103-107 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `_run_step` strips `GIT_DIR`/`GIT_WORK_TREE` from the environment, so the tests do not reproduce the production post-activation environment (the contract test also pins the broken verify line).
  WHY: The GIT_DIR leakage defect passes the tests unnoticed. Severity: NIT from minimax, hardening suggestion from others; highest used (medium assumed for MAJOR-linked test gap is not stated, so the stated NIT is kept as the source severity).
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:4110-4127 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The verify only proves the nested repo's HEAD equals SCRIPT_REF, not the integrity of the bytes of the unstaged `review_findings_record.py`, so a PR-planted or agent-modified working-tree copy could execute.
  WHY: This always() step resolves only the workspace copy, so the HEAD check can pass while planted bytes run with runner privileges. Severity: BLOCKER from gemini, MAJOR from glm; highest used.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:3296-3304,4482-4486 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]

  WHY: These sites are not covered by the new guard or by `test_every_codex_agent_workspace_fallback_is_verified`. Severity: NIT from minimax; glm called it advisory and pre-existing. The sonnet reviewer found these sites outside the issue's always() scope.
